replies.body: Plan is in docs/growth_plan.md. Biggest finding: the app is already open (free, no sign-up), but every reel ends with 'coming soon, follow for launch day', so viewers are told to wait. Say 'launch' and that flips. Then: tagged bio links to Close Call, a visit counter so we can see what works, and the auto-poster (the bot in scripts/social already does Instagram and TikTok; Facebook gets added).

Done: guerrilla is now section 0 of the plan. Street-interview reels asking strangers one Close Call question, then revealing the market's odds; QR posters and chalk ('The market says 62%. Do you?') where allowed; a weekly Humans vs. the Brain scoreboard reel; earnings-night odds posts; QR merch. No fake accounts, spam or 'guaranteed' claims.
Suggested next build: count site visits by ref tag (tt/ig/fb/qr) and how many visitors reach Close Call or a first idea, so we can see if reels and stunts work.
